## Regression review

- [ ] Checked `docs/BUG_REPORT.md` for prior defects in the affected area.
- [ ] Checked related components/pages for the same failure pattern.
- [ ] Added or updated an automated regression test that would fail on the old behavior; or documented why a manual check is the practical option.
- [ ] Verified the fix addresses the root cause, not only the visible symptom.
- [ ] Recorded validation actually run, including failures, skips and limitations.

## UI / UAT (when applicable)

- [ ] Checked responsive behavior at relevant desktop and mobile widths.
- [ ] Recorded the UAT steps/evidence needed; do not claim UAT verification until it is performed on the target site.
- [ ] Identified asset rebuild/cache refresh requirements, if any.

## Risk and rollout

- [ ] No unrelated refactor or scope expansion.
- [ ] Permissions, data changes, migrations and rollback impact reviewed where applicable.
- [ ] Follow-up work is recorded in `docs/FOLLOW_UPS.md` when not completed in this PR.
